decisions.question: FOMC tone hold: the code (and so the backtest and paper record) holds 10 calendar days; the card says 10 trading days. Which is right?
decisions.options: (a) fix the card text to calendar days; (b) change the code and register a new card (the record restarts).
decisions.recommendation: (a) — the evidence we have is for calendar days.
decisions.answer: (a) fix the card. Done 2026-10-30: appended clarification on H-20261018-14 (dev b50ae6a).

decisions.question: LLM operator you can message from anywhere: how?
decisions.options: (a) Claude Code Remote Control on Computer 4 — exists today, runs under your Claude subscription, needs the PC on; (b) a custom chat in the control panel calling an LLM API — more work, paid per use (W44-D1 rule).
decisions.recommendation: (a) now with written guardrails; (b) later if (a) is not enough.

decisions.question: Emergency STOP is absolute today: a timed exit that falls due during STOP waits until STOP is cleared. Keep that, or let timed closes run under STOP?
decisions.recommendation: Keep STOP absolute, and add a bell notice when a timed exit falls due during STOP (W45-FRI-1).

decisions.question: Phone push for the bell: set a private ntfy topic (a long random name) so alerts reach your phone?
decisions.recommendation: Yes — the old default topic was public and is now off.
decisions.answer: Later in November, with the LLM operator.
